cases: browses, restores, and deletes workspace backup versions
shows failed workspace backups without requesting missing artifacts

observed_contract: Creates a manual workspace backup through the public API.
Browses the backup in the real UI and reads the selected file.
Downloads a ZIP with the expected file and content.
Restores the backup after a live file change and observes the restored content.
Deletes the backup and observes the pre-restore backup count.
Renders a failed backup without requesting a missing artifact and disables restore.
limitations: This is real local dev workflow evidence, not packaged Desktop acceptance.
The full packaged create/browse/download/restore matrix and APFS/Windows interruption matrix remain open.
temporary_dependency_plumbing: The isolated worktree used a temporary pnpm node_modules installation and hydrated embedded-postgres dynamic-library symlinks; no source or runtime files were modified.
